insights_ml_confusion_matrix.csv.description: Phase 6 selected model; pct_of_true_role = recall row %.

insights_salary_model.csv.description: Phase 4 OLS on log salary (US 2023), % differences with 95% CI.

insights_senior_skill_odds_ratios.csv.description: Phase 4 Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel odds ratios (senior vs non-senior within role).

live_jobs_2026.csv.description: Arbeitnow API snapshot 2026-10-08, one row per posting, no description text; url = link back to the source.

live_skill_demand_2026.csv.description: Arbeitnow snapshot. Dense: skill x job_family x experience_level x remote x description_language. Same share formula.

ref_overview_2023.csv.description: data_jobs 2023. Grain: role_family x seniority x country_group x remote x month. Measures are additive counts/sums: avg salary = SUM(salary_sum)/SUM(postings_with_salary); avg skills = SUM(total_skills_listed)/SUM(postings_with_skill_data).

ref_salary_by_role_2023.csv.description: data_jobs 2023. Salary percentiles (medians are not additive, so computed in SQL); groups with >= 30 published salaries.

ref_skill_demand_2023.csv.description: data_jobs 2023. Dense: skill x role_family x seniority x country_group x remote. Share = SUM(postings_with_skill)/SUM(postings_in_group). Keep [skill] on the view or filtered.

ref_skill_trend_2023.csv.description: data_jobs 2023. Dense: skill (>=1,000 postings) x role_family x month. Same share formula.
